title: DecisionEvent
description: One recommendation the product surfaced. Emitted the moment a decision is shown to the customer -- this is turn 1 of the flywheel. Domain-generic: the specific recommendation lives in the opaque `recommendation` payload; the columns the loop needs are typed.

decision_id.description: Stable unique id for this decision (uuid). Foreign key for every downstream event.

tenant_id.description: Customer/tenant this decision belongs to. Never crosses tenants except via the anonymized benchmark.

decision_type.description: Typed, extensible kind of decision, e.g. 'price_change', 'campaign_launch', 'budget_allocation'. Drives nothing structurally -- it labels the row for slicing.

entity.description: What the decision is about, as a generic reference.

recommendation.description: Opaque, domain-specific payload of what was recommended (the price, the budget, the target). Passed through the warehouse untouched; parsed only in customer-specific layers so the core stays warehouse-agnostic.

mapping_version_id.description: THE MOAT LINK. The exact mapping version that produced this decision. Every outcome is later attributed back through this id, so you learn which mappings actually work.

model_confidence.description: The mapping's own confidence at surface time (optional).

segment.description: The customer-context dimensions lift is conditioned on. Keep these stable and low-cardinality -- they are the 'for which customer type' axis of the moat.

context.description: Optional feature snapshot the mapping saw (for later debugging/retraining).
